messages.snippet: Dear all, The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 7 February between 20:00
messages.subject: [IT] Scheduled DMS maintenance - Saturday 7 Feb, 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 7 February between 20:00 and 23:00 for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and close any open documents before 19:45. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks for your patience.
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
